title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter

suppliers.sup:70530: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – volumes and proposed terms
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. Our expected volume is 4580 pcs per year, and we are prepared to commit for 24 or 36 months instead of 12.

Our current agreement ctr:4600070530 runs on 90 days payment terms, which we would like to keep.
Forecast fc:350020@2026-09 records a 10.3% change in demand for this part, so a longer frame offers you secure, growing volume.
Your scorecard sc:70530@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 84.6%, which we need to see improve.

Please review the three attached packages. If any of them needs pricing-committee approval, could you submit it at the next session? We would also welcome your earliest possible lead time.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – volumes and proposed terms
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We have reviewed your proposals and forwarded your questions regarding lead times and delivery performance to our technical team. 

Our Angebot stands at a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months, and a Zahlungsziel 90 days net. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
